mechanism: NON SELECTIVE COOLING FOLLOWED BY SELECTIVE RE-HEAT
verdict: NOT differential cooling. Across the off period bed melt and part melt fall together at -0.00 to 1, which is not selective. The selectivity is in the RE-HEAT leg, where the part recovers 9.06 points of melt for every point the bed gains, because the dopant is in the part and the bed only heats by conduction. The cycle is a melt, erase and selectively re-melt sequence.
